title: StackReplay · Your workload. Any stack. Replay the difference.
excerpt: See what your real AI coding workload is worth at published API prices and what drives it, then replay it against other plans and APIs, privately in your browser.
content_html:
Private workload analyzer

Your AI coding history, measured.

Claude Code, Codex and Command Code keep records of your AI coding work. StackReplay reads supported history in your browser to show what drives usage, when it gets heavy and what covered calls would cost at published API prices. Replay that work against another plan or API to see how its documented rules apply.

Replayed by the production engine (0.0.4) against catalog rules as of Sep 23, 2026. 76 events with model IDs the catalog does not recognize are left out, rather than guessed. No project names, paths, session IDs or times of day are in this sample.

Your machine

Your history stays here.

Drop your home folder and StackReplay checks only the places AI coding tools keep their history. A Worker in your browser extracts models, tokens and timestamps; the raw sessions stay on your device, and prompts, responses, code and paths are never saved.

Scan your AI history ↗

Evidence

Every conclusion has a boundary.

Replay separates model availability, admission, capacity, and cost. Catalog facts carry sources and dates. Unknown limits never become made-up numbers.
